en_backup.client_response: I feel like I am in a rut.
en_backup.internal:
[Perception] She didn’t jump past what I said or try to fix it right away. Just asking what’s been going on made it feel a little safer to name it honestly. “In a rut” is the closest I could get to saying I’m not just bored — I’ve been feeling very down, kind of stuck, and embarrassed that I can’t seem to shake it on my own.

[Decision] I decided to say that much because I’m tired of pretending I’m fine, and I want help even though it feels uncomfortable. If I can admit I’m stuck without being judged, maybe I can actually talk about it instead of keeping it all bottled up.
